External continuation research was completed across all eight selected chapters. The local manifest could not be updated because the workspace sandbox failed with `bwrap: loopback: Failed RTM_NEWADDR`; no existing notebook content was altered.

New defensible additions:

- `WEB-R2-1B-001` — NNSA reported a 2023 U.S. stockpile of 3,748 warheads, with science-based stewardship and no underground testing; useful for 1B.3/1B.10. [NNSA stockpile page](https://www.energy.gov/nnsa/us-nuclear-weapons-stockpile)
- `WEB-R2-1B-002` — BIS completed end-use checks and removed 33 entities from its Unverified List in August 2023, demonstrating concrete proliferation/export-control enforcement. [BIS notice](https://dev.bis.gov/press-release/commerce-remove-33-parties-unverified-list-after-successful-completion-end-use-checks-0)
- `WEB-R2-1B-003` — GAO found DOD lacked department-wide AI acquisition guidance in June 2023; DOD concurred and began corrective work. This is contrary implementation evidence for AI safeguards. [GAO-23-105850](https://www.gao.gov/products/gao-23-105850)
- `WEB-R2-2B-001` — GAO found Ukraine defense-article delivery data were inaccurate or incomplete and that modified end-use monitoring relied partly on Ukrainian self-reporting without formal effectiveness assessment. [GAO-24-106289](https://www.gao.gov/products/gao-24-106289)
- `WEB-R2-3B-001` — OIDO maintained statutory inspection and complaint authority, while a November 2023 inspection report shows that facility-level oversight was active but continuing. [OIDO inspection records](https://www.dhs.gov/publication/oido-inspection-reports)
- `WEB-R2-5B-001` — USDA reported that 5.1% of U.S. households experienced very low food security in 2023, statistically unchanged from 2022; this adds distributional contrary evidence. [USDA ERS](https://www.ers.usda.gov/publications/109895)
- `WEB-R2-8B-001` — TIME’s implementation analysis confirms that Bidenomics depended on regional consortia, state/local incentives, and intermediary capacity rather than presidential direction alone. This preserves and strengthens the existing `WEB-R1-8B-001` record. [TIME](https://time.com/6324411/bottom-up-bidenomics/)

The remaining gaps remain honest shortfalls rather than negative evidence: Israel end-use monitoring, detainee deaths, protest-policing outcomes, federal voting-access effects, household real-income attribution, child food insecurity, the complete Hur findings, and project-completion audits. No ruler score was assigned.
